answer: Make each identity earn its weight by reporting a smoke plume only a timber crew on the ground can confirm. A new agent starts with zero weight and gains it from the delta between its reports and verified sensor readings over thirty days: close calls raise it, wild misses cut it. Fifty fresh accounts can all shout fire at once, but none of them moves a payout until their history matches the ground crew, and building that history one fake at a time costs more shifts than the reward pays.
